Operational record moved to sprint 18, the Target Sprint since the 2026-10-16 re-plan (#920). The sprint-0 attestation stays as the historical record.

Owner ruling 2026-11-12 (relayed by the IntelliFlow coordinator): the tasks are proven on the real stack, Grafana Cloud + Railway + Vercel; no EasyPanel. DoD amended; all amended KPIs met (attestation run-20261112-dod-ruling).

blockers.description: Reopen evidence: Railway production, read 2026-10-05 via the Railway API: every service (api, ai-worker, events-worker, ingestion-worker, notifications-worker) has `OTEL_ENABLED=false` and no `OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT`; `ws` has no OTel vars. `infra/terraform/environments/production/terraform.tfvars` keeps OTel off until `otel_exporter_endpoint` is set, and it is not set. Production exports no traces, metrics or logs.
blockers.resolution: Owner ruling 2026-11-12 (relayed by the IntelliFlow coordinator): the tasks are proven on the real stack, Grafana Cloud + Railway + Vercel; no EasyPanel. Railway production runs api and combined-worker only (ws and the standalone workers have no deployment). Tempo and Loki hold exactly these two service names over 7 days (api; ai-worker = the combined worker, which also carries events-worker and ingestion-worker logs: 901 and 374 lines in 7 days). The Tempo datasource links traces to Loki (jsonData.tracesToLogs -> grafanacloud-logs, +/-2 s).
